div.p: Fill out the following information to create your account. A password is optional.
div.div: This password only locks the desktop in this browser.

div.p: Select an appearance and accent colour. You can change these later in Settings.
Your desktop will ask for your password each time it starts.
Your clean glassmorphic desktop is ready. Drag windows, open apps from the Dock, or use Spotlight.

div.span: Tip: You can re-run this guide anytime from the top Help menu or Settings.
